title: What’s in a Name? Are BERT Named Entity Representations just as Good for any other Name?

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of person and organization names within the same typed class across various NLP tasks (NLI, CoRef, SQuAD, GEC) to measure performance degradation and evaluate whether models are biased toward frequent or canonical names.
Substituting country names with less frequent country names in Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) tasks to observe unintended variance in model predictions based on the country mentioned.
